description: f x = x, 0 <= x |- 0 <= f x (mixed UF + LIA)
coq_goal: forall (f : Z -> Z) (x : Z), f x = x -> 0 <= x -> 0 <= f x

Needs n-ary cong + n-ary arithmetic reification; tracked as the remaining coverage backlog.
